title: Malaysian Beef Suet Roti
description:
Crispy Malaysian dish featuring suet and binchotan-charcoal.
Suet adds a romantic, savory flavor to this traditional Malaysian recipe.
instructions: Mix together the suet, flour, yeast, and salt in a bowl.
Add the charcoal powder, oil, water, and broth to the bowl and mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 10 minutes until smooth and elastic.
Roll the dough into a ball and flatten slightly into a disk shape.
Heat a dry pan over medium heat and cook the roti for 2 minutes on each side.
Brush the roti with saffron-infused oil and cook for another minute.
Serve hot with onion, garlic, and chili pepper on top.
Onions, garlic, and chili pepper can be caramelized first for extra flavor.
Beef suet can be replaced with beef tallow for a similar taste.
Binchotan charcoal can be substituted with regular charcoal powder for a less intense flavor.
